about: BO3 movement for the Dragonborn. Tuning numbers are read from BO3's player movement settings where they exist (bo3_param); otherwise the design value is used.

rows.name: Thrust Jump
rows.rule: Jump again in the air: upward boost, fuel bar drains, refills on landing
rows.source: guess from memory of BO3; confirm against the player's BO3 files (bo3_sources)

rows.name: Slide
rows.rule: Crouch while sprinting: low fast slide that decays over BO3's slide time; can shoot while sliding
rows.source: guess from memory of BO3; confirm against the player's BO3 files (bo3_sources)

rows.name: Wall Run
rows.rule: Jump into a wall at an angle while sprinting: run along it for up to BO3's wall-run time, jump off
rows.source: guess from memory of BO3; confirm against the player's BO3 files (bo3_sources)
